# Küstencode Werkbank
An open-source, modular, self-hosted business software suite (ERP alternative) for small businesses.

## Key Metadata
- License: MIT License
- Frontend UI: MudBlazor 8.0 (Material Design)
- Backend: .NET 9, Blazor Server, EF Core 9
- Deployment: Turnkey Docker-Compose Stack
- Target Market: Germany (GoBD, XRechnung, ZUGFeRD, EÜR, DATEV)

## Modular Architecture
Every module runs as an isolated micro-container via Docker. If a user does not want to manage projects, the 'Acta' module can simply be deleted or commented out in the docker-compose.yml. The Host gateway uses Yarp and health checks to automatically discover running modules and adapt the navigation dynamically.

## Modules Included
- Faktura: Invoicing & E-Invoices
- Offerte: Quotes & Proposals
- Rapport: Time tracking
- Acta: Project & Task management (Omitable)
- Recepta: Incoming invoice OCR & automated mapping
- Saldo: Accounting, EÜR, and DATEV export
